card.name: Small words before measuring devices or water
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, an, the, with right before a device or item in administration instructions, like 'use a graduated oral syringe' or 'with a full glass of water'. Also a space after 'Phase'.

modes.label: Article before dosing device
modes.description: The word a or an after 'always use' or 'with' just before an oral syringe or measuring device.
modes.example: Strongly advise patients and caregivers to always use<< a>> graduated oral syringe when administering Morphine

modes.label: Article before meal or water
modes.description: The word a after 'with' in swallowing or taking instructions, before meal or glass of water.
modes.example: Take VENCLEXTA with<< a>> meal and water.

modes.description: The blank space between 'Phase' and the trial number.
